answer: Yes. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts, so you can sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, and we'll request the dealer payoff quote from Summit for you. Bring that quote to your appointment. If our offer is higher than the buyout amount, Summit passes the difference (your lease equity) to you.
